_comment: Field names and types, and no values, of the Airtable 'Outreach Tracker' table (tblQssm68GvGEfAEH) and of the 'Tutors' table (tbllW9yWhbg1UCHVy), read from the base's metadata API on 2026-11-11. Pins what the Outreach Tracker's import (a lead becomes a lead on the site) and the one-off institutions seed (the Tutors rows) read, so a rename in the grid fails bin/test-fixtures.php before it fails a read. The Outreach Tracker's first column, 'Ac', is the lead's name. 'Country' there is text, not a link: the import resolves it to a Countries record by name, and a name that matches none stays as text on the lead. There is no contact people column: a lead's contact person and address come over empty and an Administrator fills them on the Talks card. 'Promote to Institutions' is a button and is not read. Refresh with a metadata read when either table changes.
